# Threading Errors and Warnings

Messages reported by PostSharp.Patterns.Threading: threading models, dispatching, and deadlock detection.

| Message | Severity | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <xref:thr001?text=THR001> | Error | A method dispatched in non-blocking mode returns a value or has by-reference parameters. |
| <xref:thr006?text=THR006> | Error | A method with the [Background] aspect returns a value other than a task, or has by-reference parameters. |
| <xref:thr008?text=THR008> | Error | A class whose threading model controls access to its fields has a public or internal field. |
| <xref:thr009?text=THR009> | Error | A method of an actor that other objects can call has a ref, out or in parameter. |
| <xref:thr016?text=THR016> | Warning | A method of a reader/writer synchronized class does not say which lock it needs. |
| <xref:thr017?text=THR017> | Error | An async method of a synchronized class or of an actor does not have the [Reentrant] attribute. |
| <xref:thr018?text=THR018> | Error | A class with a threading model has a field of a mutable struct type. |
| <xref:thr019?text=THR019> | Error | A child field has a type whose threading model is not compatible with the threading model of its parent. |
| <xref:thr020?text=THR020> | Error | A child field has a type that is mutable and has no threading model. |
| <xref:thr021?text=THR021> | Error | A method of a reader-writer synchronized class has more than one access-level attribute. |
| <xref:thr022?text=THR022> | Error | The [Reentrant] attribute is applied to a method that is not async. |
| <xref:thr023?text=THR023> | Error | The [Dispatched] aspect is applied to a static method. |
| <xref:thr025?text=THR025> | Warning | The thread-safety policy finds a class with instance fields that has no threading model. |
| <xref:thr026?text=THR026> | Warning | The thread-safety policy finds a static field that any thread can assign. |
| <xref:thr027?text=THR027> | Warning | The thread-safety policy finds a static field whose type is not thread-safe. |
| <xref:thr036?text=THR036> | Error | An instance method of a thread-affine class has the [Background] aspect. |
| <xref:thr037?text=THR037> | Error | An instance method of an actor has the [Background] aspect. |
| <xref:thr039?text=THR039> | Error | An async method of an actor returns a type other than void, Task or Task<T>. |
| <xref:thr040?text=THR040> | Warning | An access level attribute such as [Reader] is applied to a static method. |
| <xref:thr041?text=THR041> | Warning | An access level attribute such as [Reader] is applied to a method of a class that has no threading model. |
| <xref:thr042?text=THR042> | Warning | [ExplicitlySynchronized] is applied to the backing field of an automatic property instead of the property. |
| <xref:thr043?text=THR043> | Warning | The appliesToMethodOnly argument of [ExplicitlySynchronized] on a property is ignored. |
